clips.title: Everyday sentence
clips.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the farmer watches from the old wooden gate.

clips.title: About speech recognition
clips.text: Speech recognition turns spoken words into written text, and it is used in phones, cars and smart speakers.

clips.title: Office request (British voice)
clips.text: Please schedule the meeting for Thursday afternoon and send the agenda to everyone on the team.

clips.text: She sells seashells by the seashore, and the shells she sells are surely seashells.
